# Spatial Gallery · Photo Memories · MotionGit .motion

Template and full package: https://motiongit.com/@prism-studio/visual-art-g-gallery
Version: 2.6.5-alpha.2
Demo available. Check the official page for current download availability.

Declared runtime profile: html-canvas/1.
Editable inputs are mapped through the template parameter schema and preset to its existing animation project.
The declared timeline has a fixed duration; new content fits its existing scene order and timing.

Use this .motion template with my content. Obtain the package from https://motiongit.com/@prism-studio/visual-art-g-gallery, extract or load it as documented, read the included README and referenced guide, reuse my working environment, and follow the package workflow to show an actual preview.
